**Repaired finding submitted: deviation (GOVLAW)**

To cure the minimal-edit ratio flag, the redline is now reduced to two word-level substitutions inside the same sentence:

- "governed exclusively by ~~Singapore~~ **New York** law"
- "the courts of ~~Singapore~~ **New York County, New York** have exclusive jurisdiction"

Everything else in 28.1 is preserved, and 28.2/28.3 are untouched. The "state and federal courts" specificity of the preferred position is already carried by 28.2, so repeating it in 28.1 was unnecessary and only inflated the edit. Substance, direction, severity (medium) and the [Playbook] comment with Delaware/California and England-and-Wales fallbacks are unchanged.
